items.claim: An unregistered outline name fell back to the built-in `rect`, not a registered `rect` that shadows it
`roundRectOutline`'s `boxForContent` used the raw `maxRadius`, so `Infinity` sized an infinite box and a negative radius sized a box smaller than its content
items.note: It is also an exact inverse now. Strict call, recorded in `docs/unruled.md`: a negative or `NaN` radius throws `RangeError`, and `Infinity` means "always a sixth of the shorter side".

items.claim: `outlineFromD` accepted path data that doesn't parse, or that draws nothing, and a `content` box with no area
items.note: Strict call, recorded in `docs/unruled.md`: it throws, the same as a mark's `d`. Marks and outlines now share one parse-and-check helper, `parseUnitD` in `outlines/fromD.ts`, instead of two copies.
